name: BT Volume as Reconstruction Filter
definition: A method to represent the result of convolving an arbitrary scalar volume with a reconstruction filter as a BT Volume, provided the filter itself is a BT Volume sharing a similar κ function.
summary: BT Volume as Reconstruction Filter convolves discrete volumetric samples with a BT filter to produce a single BT Volume, ensuring high-quality, continuous, and resolution-independent results for real-time rendering.
